title: Q-GROW-adaptive-follow-ups: Follow-up questions chosen from the first answer keep people in the interview.
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every product-manager cycle
**Done check:** grep:site/interview.js::followup
**Status:** closed

Metric moved: visitors_7d. Prediction: visitors_7d rises at least 15 percent within 14 days of the change. Adopted from the parallel CLOCKWORK branch; its probe was rewritten to a file or grep the repository can run.

Growth experiment on target `interview-completion` (interview_completion_rate target 0.5), knob `interview-questions` in `site/interview.js`: question bank and order. an idea flow that people finish. Ship the change, log the prediction, keep it if the metric moved and revert it if not.

**Closing probe:** grep:site/interview.js::followup.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 219.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
